reason: Only part of the claim holds. `santizeAnchors(String key, ...)` never uses `key` (VerifyMessageProperties.java:150-162), and the comment at L94 does misspell 'numberic'. But `getEnglishValue` does use `key` in `bundleEnglish.getString(key)` (VerifyMessageProperties.java:164-167), so the claim that both take an unused key is wrong.
